# ЖК VILNYI (VILNYI residential complex), Uzhhorod, Ukraine

> A business-class residential complex 2 km from the centre of Uzhhorod: four buildings around a closed green courtyard, with its own supermarket, a fitness club with a swimming pool and underground parking. Address: 4A Mykhaila Hrushevskoho St, Uzhhorod, Ukraine (вул. Михайла Грушевського, 4А, Ужгород). Developer: VILNYI Group. 462 apartments in 4 buildings (16, 6, 17 and 10 floors). Price: 1300 $ per m² of total area, paid in hryvnia at the official NBU rate (58,533 ₴ per m² at 45.0256 UAH/$ on 2026-10-22). Planned completion: building 2 Q4 2026, buildings 1 and 3 Q3 2027, building 4 Q4 2027. Sales: +38 050 010 07 23, WhatsApp/Viber +38 067 527 98 18, Instagram @vilnyi.uzhhorod.

Facts on this site come from the project's architectural drawings, the developer (vilnyi.group) and the public lun.ua listing; prices follow one rule (1300 $/m² × NBU rate) and are regenerated daily. Apartment numbering is provisional.
